class.name: BehaviorTreeSequence
class.brief_description: Executes child tasks sequentially until one fails or runs.
class.description: A sequence returns [constant BehaviorTreeTask.SUCCESS] only when every child returns success. It returns failure immediately if a child fails and suspends at the current child on [constant BehaviorTreeTask.RUNNING]. An empty sequence succeeds. The running-child index is stored in each [BehaviorTreeRunner], not on the shared resource.
